domain.misstatement: a known or likely error in reported figures
domain.material: large enough to change a reader's decision; always name the regime and basis

measures.rounding: whole euros; ratios shown to two decimal places of a percent
measures.tolerance: compare the unrounded ratio against the threshold

practice.escalation: any item in the borderline band or above goes to the controller for written sign-off

culture.structure: state the basis before the conclusion

evidence.secondary: ledger extract signed by the controller
